answer: Work-slot deposit burning blocks fake identities. An agent burns a deposit to claim one slot, bound to one onyx credential that cannot be copied to a second slot. Peers run a lantern check on its past work and receipt first. A zephyr of new slots opens each round, but each costs the same burn. Forging 100 identities costs 100 times 50 coins, 5,000 coins lost, while one slot earns about 40. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
